class.name: GameplayAbility
class.brief_description: Base class for in-game abilities (actions, skills, spells).
class.description: GameplayAbility defines logic for an action that an actor can perform. This can range from simple attacks to complex mechanics. It is designed to be subclassed either in C++ or GDScript to implement specific behaviors via virtual methods like [method _activate_ability]. Abilities rely on [GameplayTag]s for costs, cooldowns, and blocking conditions.

method.name: _activate_ability
method.description: Scriptable hook called when the ability is activated. Implement your logic here (play animation, spawn projectile, etc.).

method.name: _can_activate_ability
method.description: Scriptable hook to check custom conditions for activation. Should return true if the ability can be activated.

method.name: activate
method.description: Triggers the ability activation logic. Calls [method _activate_ability].

method.name: can_activate
method.description: Checks if the ability can be activated (cooldowns, costs, tags). Calls [method _can_activate_ability].

method.name: commit
method.description: Commits the ability execution, usually consuming resources (mana, stamina) and starting cooldowns.

method.name: end
method.description: Ends the ability execution. Use this to clean up states or remove tags.
